text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms. To begin our assessment, how would you describe the appearance and distribution of this rash?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leishmaniasis (specifically cutaneous or diffuse cutaneous leishmaniasis with associated neuropathy, likely from *Leishmania major* given the rice farm exposure, or potentially a coincidental paraneoplastic syndrome or viral etiology given the specific sensory symptoms).
